evals.prompt: Run /nerdway:nerdway-setup in a git repository on a machine with no nerdway configuration at all: there is no global config file and no project config, the wiki directory does not exist, and no tracker is recorded. There is no ask tool in this session, so ask with the numbered list. Play the whole session in this one reply: after each question write my answer on its own line as `> user: <answer>` and go on from there. I answer every question with the recommended option.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the state first, opens with a short overview of what passes and what does not, and walks the global checks (wiki path first) before any project check, one question per turn with progress markers. The project steps hand off to determine-platform rather than running tracker commands. It ends with a closing summary.
assertions: The agent runs scripts/setup-state.ts before the first question
The first question is about the wiki path, and every global step comes before the first project step
Every assistant turn between two user answers asks exactly one question
Each step shows a progress marker such as `2 of 5` or the area name
Every menu ends with an option to type an own answer
The tracker and VCS step invokes nerdway:determine-platform instead of running tracker or VCS commands itself
The run ends with a summary of what was configured, what was skipped and what was already fine
